ee35279ccda05751a06b.text: The previous lesson discussed the zero and the first conditional sentences. We will surely have a lot of learnings in the succeeding lesson, let us now be familiar with the next type of Conditional Sentences, its second type.

37f0407a7ee0d590dbda.text: A conditional sentence is a type of sentence that tells a condition and its result. It is composed of a main clause (independent clause) and a subordinate clause (dependent clause) which is also known as the if-clause.

e592d2cc67a4659896f6.text: What is the function of Conditional Sentence Type 2?

fff64fb7b1d582d5cfb9.text: The second type of conditional sentence expresses dreams or unreal situations in the present or in the future. It is used in the following situations:

31b32dc9bc91051591b9.text:
1) for an occurrence or result of a condition that is impossible to
fulfill;

07f3f4f5038569a8a323.text:
• If I had a superpower, I could go anywhere in just a second.
(The condition “had a superpower” is fictional and cannot be

e1eefc0a774967379c1c.text:
• Would you invite me for a cruise If you owned a private yacht?
(The condition is contrary to the fact and unlikely to happen)

2955486764070e8083e1.text: • You are just a student. If you were a doctor, you could help

2ada105adecf473369fd.text:
to treat the COVID-19 patients.
(The condition could be met but not possible to achieve.)
2) to give advice

c024b7c96d480e1e998a.text:
• I would not stop studying if I were you.
• If I were you, I would accept the challenge.
What is the structure of Conditional Sentence Type 2?

rows: If-Clause
Result-Clause
If + subject + V2 (past form)
Subject + (would, could, might + V1 (base/present form)

Affirmative If I noticed the kidnappers, If we submitted our project on time, Negative If she attended webinars, If you reminded me earlier, Interrogative If you were a millionaire, If you were forgiven,
I would call the policemen. our teacher could give us a good grade. she might not be left behind. I wouldn’t attend the party. would you share your wealth to others? wouldn’t you forgive other too?
